newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico first-half April CPI up 0.58 percent - Banco.
newsitem.headline: Mexico first-half April CPI up 0.58 percent - Banco.

text.p: Mexico's consumer price index rose 0.58 percent in the first half of April from the last two weeks of March, Banco de Mexico said on Thursday.
It said that the basic basket of consumer goods rose 0.66 percent in the first two weeks of April.

The central bankk said the main causes of inflation were local telephone services, fruits and vegetables, tax on automobiles, and automobile maintenance, urban transportation, restaurants, cookies, soft drinks and other products.
